name: Lean Progressive Context
purpose: Select the smallest sufficient context for a task under strict token budgets through staged loading, a running token ledger, sufficiency testing per layer, and Working Context Capsule handoffs.
inputs: Task statement with explicit acceptance criteria and entry-point hints
Token budget envelope: total budget, per-stage cap, and max expansion stages
Stopping condition defining what evidence proves the current layer sufficient
outputs: Minimal sufficient working set actually used for the domain work
Token ledger proving spend stayed within budget and caps
Capsule chain reconstructing the reasoning path for reviewers
stop_conditions: Acceptance criteria addressable with the current layer and expansion halted
Max expansion stages reached without sufficiency
